verdict.rationale: Fenwick's public pricing page names its alternative fee arrangements: fixed fees, value-based pricing, task-based pricing and risk-sharing. It also says over 20 percent of firm revenue comes from non-hourly billing. It describes budget-tracking dashboards shared with clients, so cost is not left entirely opaque. Missing for 10: published hourly rate ranges or example fee figures, detail on when and how each AFA structure is applied, and independent or client corroboration of these billing practices.
